findings.title: Disable the idle timer once background work completes
findings.description:
The timeout remains fixed throughout `_read_turn()`, even after a task notification clears the last active background agent. A slow foreground continuation can therefore time out, returning partial text as success without consuming its result.

Reproduced with a completion notification followed by a delayed parent answer: dispatch returned `"Waiting\nWorking"` instead of including `"DONE"`, and stopped zero tasks. Reevaluate `turns.waiting` before each read and disable the timeout when background work finishes. Add a regression test covering this transition.

findings.title: Guard model switching on unusable sessions
findings.description:
The new unusable-session guard does not cover `set_model()`. However, `_dispatch_via_session()` calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, and reconnect resets `current_model` to `None`. After a failed reconnect, subsequent batch items therefore contact the dead client before reaching the guard.

Verified with a real disconnected SDK client: this produces `CLIConnectionError: Not connected. Call connect() first.`, losing the recorded reconnect cause. Guard `set_model()` too, and test with a client that rejects calls while disconnected rather than an unconditional `AsyncMock`.

findings.title: Add load coverage for persistent-session dispatch
findings.description:
The added tests exercise short scripted sequences, but no load test covers the new stream-consumption and background-task lifecycle. Existing `tests/load/` coverage concerns grep and worktrees, not SDK sessions.

The Python rules require realistic load coverage for concurrency/network paths. Add a CI-gated test exercising repeated dispatches and concurrent task notifications, with latency or resource-bound assertions.
